basicInfo.name: Dongyoung
basicInfo.flavor: Reborn through the fathomless dark blessing of Judas, Dongyoung wielded overwhelming powers that seemed to embody death itself. Those who stood in his path perished in horrific ruin, unable to even let out a scream.

Normal Attack.desc:
Single Enemy
 - Deals damage equal to 120% of Magic Attack 1 time(s).
 - 50% chance to inflict Deadly Poison. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 120% of Physical Attack.

Skill 1.name: Breath of the Underworld
Skill 1.desc:
All Enemies
 - Deals damage equal to 70% of Magic Attack 1 time(s).
 - Deals additional Fixed damage equal to 22% of Magic Attack against targets inflicted with [Poison].
 - All Allies
 - Grants a Barrier equal to 65% of the caster's Magic Attack. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 70% of Physical Attack.

Skill 2.name: Touch of the Abyss
Skill 2.desc:
All Enemies
 - Deals Piercing damage equal to 155% of Magic Attack 1 time(s).
 - 45% chance to inflict Fear. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - 75% chance to inflict Deadly Poison. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 155% of Physical Attack.

Passive.name: Companion of the Underworld
Passive.desc:
Self
 - Grants Attack-Based Effect Hit Rate Boost. [Always Active]
 - Awakening Gauge Boost increases to 40 upon triggering Indomitable.
 - Revives with Indomitable upon falling in battle. [Ends After: Taking 8 Hit(s)] [Once per Battle]
 - All Allies
 - Grants Magic Damage Boost. [Always Active]
 - Heals HP equal to 65% of the caster's Magic Attack upon triggering Indomitable.
 - All Enemies
 - Deals damage equal to 50% of Magic Attack 1 time(s) when an ally activates a skill 2 time(s).
 - 100% chance to inflict Deadly Poison when an ally activates a skill 2 time(s). [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - 100% chance to inflict 1 stack(s) of Incoming Healing Reduction when an ally activates a skill 2 time(s). [Max 3 Stack(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Effect: Magic Damage Boost to 20%.
Transcend Lv.2 Effect
 - Allies in Row w/ Self (Magic)
 - Adds Effect: All Damage Immunity. [Duration: 1 Turn(s)]
Transcend Lv.6 Effect
 - Self
 - Adds Effect: Increases Indomitable effect's hit count by 1 hit(s) when an ally falls in battle.
 - All Enemies
 - Adds Effect: 100% chance to inflict 20% Magic Vulnerability. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]

Awaken Skill.name: Mortal Verdict
Awaken Skill.desc:
All Enemies
 - Deals damage equal to 145% of Magic Attack 1 time(s).
 - Deals additional Fixed damage equal to 23% of Magic Attack against targets inflicted with [Poison].
 - 100% chance to inflict Buff Duration Reduction. [Reduced by: 2 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 160% of Magic Attack.
 - Increases Damage: To 26% Fixed damage.

profile.likes: Judas, Hayeon, the Abyss, contemplation, teasing someone he likes
profile.dislikes: Sunran, justice, the bright light of the Surface World

basicInfo.flavor: Dongyoung would approach the poor souls who had fallen into the Abyss, and amidst their sinking despair, would goad and encourage them with promises that there might still be a way out.
